name: Hamamatsu Photonics Main Factory Building No. 5
aliases: Hamamatsu Photonics Ichino Factory front-end building
summary: A new four-storey building, with a basement, for front-end opto-semiconductor wafer processing at Hamamatsu Photonics' main factory in Ichino-cho, Hamamatsu, Shizuoka Prefecture, connected by cleanroom to the existing front-end building. Hamamatsu first said in February 2023 that it planned such a building for 8-inch wafers and gave details in June 2023: it adds an 8-inch line alongside the plant's existing 6-inch silicon lines and roughly doubles front-end production space, with automated transport. Construction began in July 2023 and the building was completed in June 2025, with about 10,961 m² of floor space. Hamamatsu puts the total cost, including production equipment, at about ¥37 billion and the capacity at about 8,000 wafers a month in 8-inch equivalent, and scheduled operations to begin in December 2025.

location.note: The 2025 release names the same lot in Chuo-ku that the 2023 release gave in Higashi-ku; the 2025 release title calls the site the Ichino Factory.

metrics.note: Total construction cost including production equipment, unchanged from the 2023 announcement.
Wafers per month converted to 8-inch (200 mm) wafers.

milestones.note: A release about a new Shingai Factory building said Hamamatsu planned a front-end building for 8-inch wafers at its main factory within three years.
Ceremony date set in the June 2023 release that detailed the building.
Completion announced on 17 June 2025, with a completion ceremony scheduled for 20 June 2025.

Hamamatsu Photonics completes a new building at the Ichino Factory to enhance the production capacity of optical semiconductor devices.

notes: No source found in November 2026 reports that operations began in December 2025 as scheduled, so the status stays under construction as of the newest report on the completed building. The 6-inch lines are in the existing building; this record covers the new building only. Hamamatsu also built a separate back-end building at its Shingai Factory, which is outside the scope of this dataset.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Dated the announcement to Hamamatsu's February 2023 release, which first named the planned 8-inch front-end building, and recorded the June 2023 groundbreaking date as scheduled; no report of the December 2025 start of operations was found, so the status stays under construction.
